tools.name: eth_get_balance
tools.description: Get native token balance for an address on Ethereum mainnet. Returns balance in wei (hex and decimal) and in ether.

tools.name: eth_get_block
tools.description: Get block data by number or tag on Ethereum mainnet. Use hex block number (e.g. "0x1") or "latest". Returns full block object with transaction hashes.

params.name: block
params.description: Block number as hex (e.g. "0x1") or tag ("latest", "earliest", "pending")

tools.name: eth_get_transaction
tools.description: Get transaction details by hash on Ethereum mainnet. Returns full transaction object including from, to, value, input data, and status.

params.name: hash
params.description: Transaction hash (32 bytes, hex-encoded with 0x prefix)

tools.name: eth_get_logs
tools.description: Get event logs matching a filter on Ethereum mainnet. Requires at least fromBlock and toBlock. Optionally filter by contract address and topics.

params.name: topics
params.description: Array of topic filters. Each element is a topic hash, null for wildcard, or an array of topic hashes for OR matching.

params.name: address
params.description: Contract address to filter logs

params.name: toBlock
params.description: Block number as hex (e.g. "0x1") or tag ("latest", "earliest", "pending")

params.name: fromBlock
params.description: Block number as hex (e.g. "0x1") or tag ("latest", "earliest", "pending")

tools.name: eth_gas_price
tools.description: Get current gas price on Ethereum mainnet in wei (hex string). Use to estimate transaction costs.

tools.name: eth_estimate_gas
tools.description: Estimate gas required for a transaction on Ethereum mainnet. Returns gas estimate as hex string.

params.name: to
params.description: Destination address

params.name: data
params.description: ABI-encoded call data

params.name: from
params.description: Sender address

params.name: value
params.description: Value to send in wei (hex)

tools.name: eth_get_transaction_receipt
tools.description: Get transaction receipt by hash on Ethereum mainnet. Returns status (0x1=success, 0x0=fail), gasUsed, contractAddress (for contract deployments), and event logs.

params.name: hash
params.description: Transaction hash (32 bytes, hex-encoded with 0x prefix)

tools.name: eth_get_code
tools.description: Get bytecode at an address on Ethereum mainnet. Returns "0x" for EOAs (wallets), non-empty hex for contracts. Use to determine if an address is a contract or EOA, and to retrieve deployed bytecode.

params.name: block
params.description: Block to query (default: "latest")

tools.name: eth_get_token_balance
tools.description: Get ERC-20 token balance for a wallet address on Ethereum mainnet. Returns raw balance, formatted balance with decimals, and token symbol. Calls balanceOf, decimals, and symbol on the token contract.

params.name: token
params.description: ERC-20 token contract address

params.name: wallet
params.description: Wallet address to check balance for

tools.name: eth_get_token_info
tools.description: Get ERC-20 token metadata for a token address on Ethereum mainnet. Returns name, symbol, decimals, and total supply (raw and formatted). Degrades gracefully — any individual call failure returns null for that field.

params.name: token
params.description: ERC-20 token contract address

tools.name: btc_get_balance
tools.description: Get confirmed and unconfirmed balance for a Bitcoin address on Bitcoin mainnet. Returns balance in satoshis.

params.name: address
params.description: Bitcoin address (P2PKH, P2SH, P2WPKH, P2WSH, or P2TR)

tools.name: btc_get_history
tools.description: Get transaction history for a Bitcoin address on Bitcoin mainnet. Returns list of transactions with heights and tx hashes.

params.name: address
params.description: Bitcoin address (P2PKH, P2SH, P2WPKH, P2WSH, or P2TR)

tools.name: btc_get_utxos
tools.description: Get unspent transaction outputs (UTXOs) for a Bitcoin address on Bitcoin mainnet. Returns list of unspent outputs with tx hash, position, height, and value in satoshis.

params.name: address
params.description: Bitcoin address (P2PKH, P2SH, P2WPKH, P2WSH, or P2TR)

tools.name: btc_get_transaction
tools.description: Get full transaction details by txid on Bitcoin mainnet. Returns verbose transaction data including inputs, outputs, confirmations, and block hash.

params.name: txid
params.description: Transaction ID (64 hex characters)

tools.name: btc_get_block
tools.description: Get block header data by height on Bitcoin mainnet. Returns parsed header with hash, version, previous block hash, merkle root, timestamp, bits, and nonce.

params.name: height
params.description: Block height

tools.name: btc_get_fee_estimate
tools.description: Get fee rate estimate on Bitcoin mainnet for a target number of blocks. Returns estimated fee in BTC/kB and sat/byte. Use target=1 for next-block, target=6 for ~1 hour. Returns -1 if no estimate available.

params.name: target
params.description: Target number of blocks for confirmation (default: 6)

tools.name: btc_get_mempool_info
tools.description: Get mempool fee histogram on Bitcoin mainnet. Returns array of [fee_rate, cumulative_vsize] pairs showing the distribution of transactions in the mempool by fee rate (sat/vB).

tools.name: btc_testnet_get_balance
tools.description: Get confirmed and unconfirmed balance for a Bitcoin address on Bitcoin testnet3. Returns balance in satoshis.

params.name: address
params.description: Bitcoin address (P2PKH, P2SH, P2WPKH, P2WSH, or P2TR)

tools.name: eth_lookup_selector
tools.description: Look up a 4-byte function or error selector against 4byte.directory. Returns matching function/error signatures. Useful for identifying unknown calldata selectors or decoding custom errors.

params.name: selector
params.description: 4-byte selector (0x-prefixed, e.g. 0x70a08231)

tools.name: eth_get_abi
tools.description: Fetch a verified contract's ABI from Sourcify by address. Returns the full ABI array and match type ('full' or 'partial'). Returns match_type 'none' for unverified contracts. Defaults to Ethereum mainnet (chain_id 1).

params.name: address
params.description: Contract address

params.name: chain_id
params.description: EVM chain ID (default: 1 for Ethereum mainnet)

tools.name: eth_resolve_ens
tools.description: Resolve an ENS name to its Ethereum address. Returns null if the name is not registered or has no address record. Example: 'vitalik.eth' → '0xd8dA6BF26964aF9D68eC99A6d99030B4ec93B700'.

params.name: name
params.description: ENS name to resolve (e.g. 'vitalik.eth')

tools.name: eth_lookup_address
tools.description: Reverse-resolve an Ethereum address to its primary ENS name. Returns null if no primary ENS name is set for the address.

params.name: address
params.description: Ethereum address to reverse-resolve
